grh_7c71f13250392ee0e696.title: Melody Ranch - Ragtime Cowboy Joe 50-09-30
paragraphs: Gene opens this Melody Ranch broadcast with 'Ragtime Cowboy Joe' and mixes music and comedy with a western story about old prospector Caleb Hooten, whom Gene once found panning for gold with his mule Clarence. grh_7c3b670e80e1a9965289.title: Silver Threads
paragraphs: When Homer Danfield is shot and robbed, the one usable clue is a tune associated with the attack: 'Silver Threads Among the Gold.' Britt remembers itinerant guitarist Toby Yeager teaching him that same song and helps the sheriff track him down. Singing the tune alone is not proof, and Toby initially seems to have a plausible explanation for his movements. Then a local poker player reveals that Toby lost his entire railroad pay the night of the shooting, while Toby is now carrying forty-eight unexplained dollars. Confronted with that contradiction, Toby admits that he shot Homer.

grh_7cdfc6070e21dbfafa17.title: Secret Life of Walter
paragraphs: During an ordinary shopping trip, Walter Mitty repeatedly escapes his timid everyday life through elaborate heroic fantasies. Mundane errands and his wife's instructions turn in his imagination into adventures in which he becomes a fearless military commander, a brilliant expert, a courtroom sharpshooter and a master detective. Each fantasy is abruptly punctured by traffic, shop clerks or some other small embarrassment. Left waiting outside in the rain, Mitty retreats once more into imagination and pictures himself calmly facing a firing squad, undefeated to the last.
